g.text: Figure 1 · Enlargement, local response and sustained competition
All five established linear models. B/C: own references L19, Holmes L20, Spring resting L₀ = 1; all 97 eligible sizes retained.
C uses the common active-loss assay; native τ: WP/H 0.1778, G 0.005623, deBelly 5, Spring 0.01778. Compare size folds within each model.
D After the same prolonged local cue and 13,000 cue-free units: every eligible size
One common final-stage y scale; no negative excess is clipped. Fixed original and mirrored regions are not tracked site identities.
Squares select the prespecified largest eligible size shown below; open circles flag cue/core overlap. Ineligible preparations receive no response.
E Exact native histories at the largest eligible size in every model
Fractional native coordinate: incumbent at 0, challenge at 1; Spring uses its material coordinate
Zero-based native concentration bars differ by model. Cyan marks withdrawal; displayed histories cover 0–4T; D uses the full 13,000-unit follow-up.
Fixed endpoint support 3 (Spring 0.2); native peaks WP 0.1 / G 6.4 / deBelly 3.6 / H 1 / Spring 4. Half/double durations remain linked sensitivities.
